text_html:
Source for the A14 & A16 releases

Core Lineout A16 source is here: https://github.com/los-tv-x86

A14 source follows @hmtheboy154 's source here: https://github.com/lineageos-tv-x86 with the device tree and manifest using https://github.com/Bliss-Bass/android_device_generic_x86_64_tablet and https://github.com/Bliss-Bass/lineage_bass_android repos

The ax86-toolkit source is private, but not required for contributors
